description: Booked nights and the open date ranges a stay can actually be booked in, with minimum-stay rules applied. bookableUntil is the first night the host's booking window has not opened yet (null for no limit); nights after it are not open rather than taken. Defaults to the next 90 days; at most 365 days per call. Ranges are check-in inclusive, check-out exclusive.

from.description: First date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

to.description: Day after the last date to check, YYYY-MM-DD.
